token_budget._comment: EARLY-WARNING token-burn estimate (hooks/pre-tool/15-token-budget-guard.sh + hooks/session/15-token-budget-status.sh). GROUND TRUTH is Claude Code's `/usage` command (authoritative server-side session + weekly %); this hook is an on-disk APPROXIMATION because the real rate-limit % is NOT persisted to any file a hook can read (verified 2026-06-10: stats-cache.json has cumulative tokens only; sessions/*.json is process metadata). It sums actual OUTPUT tokens from transcripts under ~/.claude/projects (the cross-repo, account-level signal a per-repo action counter can't see). CALIBRATED 2026-06-10 against a real /usage reading: estimator showed ~2.76M output tokens / 5h across all repos when /usage reported 63% of the session limit, so 100% ~= 4.4M output tokens. RECALIBRATE when it drifts: run /usage, note its session %, read the session-start hook's token count, set output_budget = count / (pct/100). Window anchoring is approximate (fixed 300-min lookback vs Anthropic's first-use-anchored 5h window) so treat as an early nudge, not a precise gauge. Warn-only — never blocks. The checkpoint threshold fires a MANDATORY auto-handoff directive EARLY so hitting the wall is always survivable.

usage_ground_truth._comment: Periodic /usage ground-truth nudge. The agent cannot run /usage itself (interactive Claude Code command — no tool/MCP surface), so when burn is elevated this emits a THROTTLED reminder to run /usage (or ask the user to) for the authoritative server-side %, since the metering above is only an estimate. interval_minutes throttles the nudge (default every 2 min); floor_percent is the higher-of session/rolling % at/above which it starts. Warn-only.
